integrity: All claims derive from exact monomial shift formulas and an explicit derivative and Taylor analysis; experimental checks do not prove infinite assertions. Historical priority is qualified.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the critical bounded-degree window in unweighted analytic Bergman space. Does not classify all finite exponents or resolve the O(1/n) fractional-part transition layer.
title: Arithmetic switching of Bergman Toeplitz norming modes at a critical degree ratio
